title: Every finite-cutoff Gaussian Q-space variational trial stays on the N^4 scale

variational_boundary.gaussian_class: Let E_N^Gauss be the infimum over every normalized finite-cutoff Gaussian Q-space wavefunction whose modulus squared is N(m,S) with arbitrary m and S>0 and whose phase is real linear-quadratic
variational_boundary.lower_boundary: K1529--K1530 split on V_N=Tr(Lambda S): high integrated variance pays Omega_g(N^4) interaction energy and low integrated variance pays Omega(N^4) free covariance energy; mean and phase costs are nonnegative
variational_boundary.vacuum_upper: The vacuum belongs to the class and has Rayleigh quotient 6gC_N^2=O(N^4), hence E_N^Gauss=Theta_g(N^4) for every fixed g>0
variational_boundary.route_decision: No coherent, squeezed, nonstationary or off-diagonal finite-cutoff Gaussian wavefunction can match K1519's unrestricted order-N^2 lower scale
variational_boundary.surviving_route: Any order-N^2 upper trial must be genuinely non-Gaussian in the fixed Q-space representation, or change the representation/domain in a way that changes the admitted problem; none is constructed here
variational_boundary.restricted_recentering: Every a_N=o(N^4) leaves all Rayleigh quotients in the Gaussian trial class divergent to plus infinity, but this is not an operator spectral or resolvent bound because non-Gaussian vectors remain in the full form domain
variational_boundary.brst_transfer: Tensoring a classified Gaussian matter vector with a harmonic BRST vector preserves its Rayleigh quotient, so only the restricted Gaussian N^4 boundary transfers; no continuum interacting BRST charge, physical cohomology or GU state space is constructed
variational_boundary.unrestricted_corridor: The true ground energy still has only K1519's c_gN^2 lower bound and K1516's nonmatching one-sided upper descent from 6gC_N^2; its asymptotic, localization, compactness and Mosco recovery remain open
